0.original: Mogret is in desperate need of a bath.

1.original: A popular moogle bathing spot has been taken over by half-fish, half-dragon monstrosities called hropkens. Slay three of them, scattering the beasts so Mogret can finally clean under her wings.

2.original: You have slain the hropkens, although their odor still remains fresh in your nose. Return to Mogret and inform her that the waters are once again safe.

3.original: Mogret is overjoyed at your news, and explains that she can't stand the smell of raw fish. She suggests that maybe <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> should also consider taking a dip in the waters.

48.original: Have you ever bathed in the waters to the northeast? Of course not, because a gang of burly hropkens has been attacking any who goes near them, kupo! If you were kind enough to slay a few, that might scare them away, giving me time for a dip in the waters.

49.original: Surely half-dragon, half-fish beasts don't need those waters like <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> do. Scare them away so I can finally get myself clean.

50.original: Many thanks, brave adventurer! Finally I can enjoy a bath without the smell of raw dragon-fish assaulting my senses. <sniff> ...Say, a dip in the waters might serve to, uh...<hex:021A020203>freshen<hex:021A020103> you up as well, kupo!
